Use case: compositing / ads-marketing.
Asset: replacement Open Graph image for TVSI Helpdesk, landscape 1200:630 aspect ratio, finished artwork edge to edge.
Input 1 is the OLD rejected cover, supplied only as the edit target. Input 2 is the authoritative official TVSI logo, the identity to preserve accurately.
Redesign input 1 completely. REMOVE the red ribbon sculpture and all abstract interlocking objects. The user rejected them because they do not resemble the actual TVSI emblem.
New art direction: the official TVSI logo itself is the hero. One large, perfectly front-facing full official lockup: its actual red circular emblem on the left and the exact black TVSI wordmark on the right. Reproduce the emblem silhouette and precise angular white negative-space channels from input 2 without redesign, distortion, rotation or perspective. Reproduce the TVSI letterforms from the official logo, not a replacement generic font. The lockup spans around 72% of the canvas width, centered optically. Beneath the black wordmark place ONLY the word "Helpdesk" in refined dark charcoal humanist sans-serif, smaller and with comfortable spacing.
Premium art direction through material and lighting rather than invented shapes: shallow satin red enamel emblem and shallow matte charcoal lettering, mounted on a seamless warm-white architectural surface. Flat unwarped front faces and only subtle 3mm edge depth. Soft oblique daylight from upper left, finely controlled contact shadows, restrained tactile realism. Camera exactly front-on with no perspective distortion. Quiet, elegant, confident, recognizably TVSI even at thumbnail size.
Clean generous space around the centered lockup, all content within 80px safe area at 1200px width. Background fills the image; no frame, no card, no room or other furniture.
Only text: the original "TVSI" wordmark and "Helpdesk".
STRICT AVOID: red ribbons, loops, abstract approximations of the emblem, extra decorative sculpture, multiple logos, slogans, process steps, arrows, numbers, subtitle, footer, supporting copy, charts, UI screenshots, gloss blobs, lens flares, neon, watermarks. This is brand artwork, not an infographic or presentation slide.
icon:
Use case: logo-brand, precise-object-edit.
Asset: the actual app icon for TVSI Helpdesk, square 1024x1024 PNG.
Input image is the existing official TVSI circular emblem. Preserve its exact recognizable geometry and proportions, including the distinctive interlocking diagonal white channels, without adding or inventing any symbol.
Create a beautifully finished contemporary application icon: an almost edge-to-edge soft-cornered square of rich TVSI red (#D2353B to vivid corporate red), with the exact TVSI circular emblem centered in white as a monochrome reversed mark. The emblem is large and visually clear, approximately 72% of canvas width. Preserve the circular emblem perimeter and diagonal negative-space geometry accurately. Restrained satin surface and a tiny refined bevel around the red tile perimeter only; the white emblem itself is flat and razor sharp.
Orthographic perfectly front-facing composition, no perspective or tilt. At small favicon size it must read as a bold red tile and clear white TVSI emblem, no fragile fine details.
No words, no letters, no slogans, no workflows, no arrows, no extra decorations, no glows, no mockup phone, no background scene. Transparent background ONLY outside the red rounded tile; no white or checkerboard backdrop. Deliver only one finished icon, not a contact sheet.

Use case: ads-marketing, compositing.
Asset: finished Open Graph social cover for the real TVSI Helpdesk application, wide landscape about 1200:630.
Image 1 is the rejected cover to completely redesign. Image 2 is the official TVSI logo supporting insert: preserve its exact red circular symbol and black TVSI wordmark, do not invent a logo.
Primary request: replace the flat document-like cover with a refined, art-directed brand image. The user emphatically rejects slogans, workflows and explanatory text on the image.
Visual: an elegant sculptural pair of interlocking folded ribbon forms in TVSI red, suggesting conversation and connection in an abstract way. Matte lacquered red surfaces with subtle bevels, tactile soft studio illumination, sculptural shadows on an off-white seamless backdrop. Restrained, confident financial-services brand art, premium editorial campaign quality. One strong coherent sculpture, ample negative space, no busy decorations. The sculpture occupies the right half, visually balanced with confident typography on the left.
Text: only the official supplied TVSI logo and the single word "Helpdesk" beneath it, typeset large in a beautiful dark charcoal rounded humanist sans-serif. Together they name TVSI Helpdesk. No other text whatsoever.
Composition: spacious 40:21 landscape, sharp legible typography and exact logo, 70px safe area all around at 1200px width; optical balance rather than cards, frames or divider lines.
Absolutely remove ALL existing slogans, process steps, numbered stages, arrows, footer company name and category labels. No taglines, no workflows, no arrows, no diagrams, no UI screenshots, no gradients for decoration, no floating glass orbs, no blue or purple, no stock-market charts, no tiny detail, no watermark. Final deliverable is the cover image itself edge to edge, not an image of a poster or device.
